description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Sprouting Thrinax, adding {R}.
When Sprouting Thrinax dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Sprouting Thrinax trigger, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability three times by sacrificing the Saprolings, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Sprouting Thrinax from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.
